lessons.title: 同じ数を2回使える？
lessons.originalRecordJSON:

  "track": "読む",
  "topic": "Map / 重複",
  "title": "同じ数を2回使える？",
  "code": "const seen = new Map();\nconst nums = [3, 3];\nlet answer = [];\nfor (let i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {\n  const j = seen.get(6 - nums[i]);\n  if (j !== undefined) {\n    answer = [j, i]; break;\n  }\n  seen.set(nums[i], i);\n}\nconsole.log(answer);",

    "[0, 1]",
    "[]"

  "recall": "なぜ先に seen.set をすると危険？",
  "output": "[0,1]",
  "contentVersion": "2026-10-12.2",
  "authors": [
    {
      "type": "ai-assisted",
      "name": "Original interview-practice material"
    }
  ],
  "sources": []
}
